abstract: A 17-month-old girl with a vaginal embryonal carcinoma (germ cell tumour) is reported. Alpha-fetoprtoein (AFP) was elevated before treatment in blood and vaginal fluid. Normal levels of AFP in blood and vaginal fluid were found after radiation and comination chemotherapy. By an indirect immunoperoxidase staining AFP was demonstrated in tumour tissue. 24-month-old local recurrence was preceded by a slight increase in serum AFP, and AFP could also be demonstrated in vaginal fluid and vaginal smears.
abstract_ja: 17か月の女児の膣胎児性癌（胚細胞腫瘍）を報告する。治療前、血液と膣液でαフェトプロテイン(AFP)が上昇していた。放射線療法と併用化学療法後、血液および膣液のAFPは正常値となった。間接免疫ペルオキシダーゼ染色により、腫瘍組織にAFPが検出された。24か月時点の局所再発に先立ち、血清AFPがわずかに上昇し、膣液および膣スメアでもAFPが検出された。
